image_description: A white minibus with purple stripes and 'Blackstone River Valley SHUTTLE' text on the front header. The vehicle is parked on a paved surface with concrete bollards in the foreground and trees/buildings in the background. It features a cutaway van chassis design with a high roof, large side windows, and an open sliding door.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic cutaway van profile: a distinct cab section followed by a boxy passenger compartment. The height-to-length ratio confirms it is a minibus rather than a full-size transit bus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, two-pane windshield is clearly visible. A series of rectangular passenger windows runs along the side of the bus body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus has significant vertical clearance. The entrance door is located immediately behind the driver's cabin (front-mid position) and is currently open.
The door mechanism appears to be a bi-fold or sliding type typical of shuttle buses, positioned correctly between the cab and the first passenger window.
The front end features a standard van grille, headlights, and bumper, indicating a front-engine layout consistent with Ford E-Series cutaway chassis.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a front-three-quarter angle; the rear of the vehicle is completely occluded and outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus is painted white with a distinctive purple stripe and specific branding ('Blackstone River Valley') on the destination sign header.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is a standard commercial van wheel with a steel rim and hubcap, proportional to the vehicle size.
Based on the number of side windows (approx. 3-4 visible) and overall length, the capacity aligns with the 4-10 passenger range typical for this class of vehicle.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific vehicle taxonomy and distinguish it from similar classes like vans or full-size buses.
To verify the legibility and structural integrity of the 'Blackstone River Valley' text, a common failure point in AI generation.
To ensure the bus sits correctly on the pavement and does not merge with the background trees or bollards.
To check for clean separation between the tires and the bodywork, ensuring no melting or fuzzy edges.

focus_areas: Text rendering quality on the header sign
Geometric consistency of the wheel arches and tires
Boundary sharpness between the bus and the background foliage
Structural plausibility of the side mirror assembly
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the front header. AI often generates gibberish here. Also, inspect the connection points of the side mirrors and the door hinges for any signs of structural melting or illogical attachment.
